name: pickle-heaven-rpi-sdk
description: Raspberry Pi 現場控制軟件套件（MQTT Broker + Gateway Agent）

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm run install -w gateway-agent && npm run install -w cli
scripts.build-all: npm run build -w gateway-agent && npm run build -w cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w gateway-agent && npm run test -w cli
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w gateway-agent && npm run lint -w cli
